  • Method Details

    • browse

      public List<Listing> browse(BrowseQuery query)
      Returns the listings a buyer can see, searched, filtered and sorted (Task 1.3). Only approved listings that are Live, Reserved or Lent and whose seller is active are shown. A price range keeps only Sell listings inside it. When sorting by price, listings without a price (Lend and Giveaway) come after all Sell listings, newest first.
      Parameters:
      query - search settings
      Returns:
      matching listings
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the price range is invalid

    • isVisibleToBuyers

      Returns:
      true if its status is browsable and its seller's account is active

    • openListing

      public Listing openListing(String buyerId, String listingId)

      Returns:
      the listing
      Throws:

    • reportListing

      public Report reportListing(String buyerId, String listingId, ReportReason reason, String comment)
      Reports a listing to the admin (Task 1.4).
      Parameters:
      buyerId - reporting buyer
      listingId - listing
      reason - reason (required)
      comment - optional comment; required when the reason is OTHER
      Returns:
      the stored report
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the reason (or the comment for OTHER) is missing
      MarketplaceException - if the buyer already has an open report on this listing
